pricing.product_hero_title: One app for every electric car.
pricing.product_hero_subtitle: Charging maps, trip planning, real costs, smart charge — and live Tesla commands if you've got one.
pricing.any_ev_body: Maps, trips, cost tracking and smart charging work with any EV — Renault, VW, Hyundai, BMW, Tesla, whatever you drive. Got a Tesla? You also get live commands.
pricing.feat_cost_title: Know exactly what driving costs you.
pricing.feat_cost_body: Snap your electricity bill or upload a photo. Flux reads it with OCR, extracts the cost per kWh, and separates what your EV used from the rest of the house.
pricing.feat_map_title: Find a charger. Anywhere in Europe.
pricing.feat_map_body: 150,000+ stations, filtered by speed and connector type. Works for any EV — no account needed.
pricing.feat_trip_title: Plan the trip. Skip the range anxiety.
pricing.feat_trip_body: Set a destination and Flux calculates charging stops along the way — fastest, most balanced or cheapest route. Real-time traffic included.
pricing.feat_smart_body: Flux tracks energy prices and shows you the cheapest window to plug in. Same charge, smaller bill — automatically.
pricing.feat_commands_title: Your Tesla. Your couch. Full control.
pricing.feat_commands_body: Lock the doors, start the climate, set charge limits — straight from your Flux dashboard. Live data updates every 30 seconds.
pricing.feat_commands_note: Live commands available for Tesla. More brands on the roadmap.
pricing.roadmap_subtitle: We build in the open. Here's what's on our roadmap.
pricing.road_photo_body: Photograph the consumption graph on your car's display — Flux extracts and analyses the data. Works with any brand.
pricing.road_trip_cost_body: Link a charging receipt to a trip and see exactly what that journey cost — fuel equivalent included.
pricing.road_battery_body: Track degradation week by week from your SoC history — for any EV, not just Tesla.
pricing.road_mileage_body: Tag trips as personal or business. Export a clean report for expenses or tax returns.
pricing.pricing_section_subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when your data history grows.
pricing.freeDesc: Full access to all core features
pricing.proDesc: Unlimited history, AI insights and more
pricing.trust_stripe: Cancel anytime · No card for Free · Secure payments by Stripe
pricing.faq_q1: Do I need a Tesla to use Flux?
pricing.faq_a1: No. Maps, trip planning, cost tracking and smart charging work with any electric car. A Tesla unlocks extra live commands — lock, climate, charge limits — inside the app.
pricing.faq_q2: Is it safe to connect my car?
pricing.faq_a2: Yes. We connect through Tesla's official Fleet API — Flux never sees your password. You can revoke access anytime from Settings.
pricing.faq_a3: Your bills, trips and consumption stay yours. We use them only to power your dashboard, never sell them. Export or delete everything at any time.
pricing.faq_a4: Yes, anytime in two taps. Your Pro features stay active until the end of the paid period, then you drop to Free — no data is lost.
pricing.faq_q5: My car isn't a Tesla — what actually works for me?
pricing.faq_a5: Everything except live commands: charging map, trip planner with stops, Cost Intelligence, and Smart Charge price alerts. Built for any EV from day one.

pricing.road_fuel_body: Flux won’t stay EV-only. Add your petrol, diesel, hybrid or plug-in hybrid car and track costs, documents and reminders the same way.
pricing.road_insurance_body: Keep your RCA and CASCO policies in one place, see expiry at a glance, and renew or compare offers without leaving the app.
pricing.road_vignette_body: Buy and verify your Romanian rovinieta — plus vignettes for Hungary, Austria and more — straight from Flux before you cross the border.
pricing.road_tolls_body: Pay the Fetești–Cernavodă and Calafat–Vidin bridge tolls in seconds and keep every receipt in one place.
pricing.road_tax_body: Estimate your annual car tax, track your ITP (technical inspection) date, and never miss a deadline.
pricing.road_reminders_body: One timeline for every expiry — insurance, rovinieta, ITP, tax and vignettes — with alerts well before each one runs out.
pricing.road_weather_body: Get alerted when rain, frost, heat, or storms threaten your parked car.

v2.index_intro: The redesign, running beside the app. Same data, same commands — only the screens are new. Nothing here can break what you use every day.
v2.index_note: Open the same screen in both and judge on the phone, not on a laptop. Anything broken that turns up while redesigning gets fixed in the real app too, not only here.
v2.pair_key_hint: Open this from the phone that has the Tesla app, standing next to the car. Until the key is approved in the car, every command is refused.
